name: Sunburn
patient_description: I fell asleep in the sun and my skin is bright red and blistering.

name: Overheated
patient_description: I've been out in the heat all day and I feel awful.

name: Insect sting
patient_description: A wasp stung me and it's really swollen.

name: Found cold
patient_description: They found me on the floor. I was there all night and I'm frozen.

name: Neck pain
patient_description: My neck hurts since the car crash.

name: Smells of alcohol
patient_description: I've only had a few. Maybe more than a few.

name: Punched in the face
patient_description: Someone punched me in the face and my nose won't stop bleeding.

name: Multiple injuries
patient_description: The car hit us head-on. Everything hurts and I feel faint.

name: Breathed in smoke
patient_description: There was a fire and the smoke was everywhere. I can't stop coughing.

name: Crushed limb
patient_description: My leg was trapped under it for ages. It's swollen and I can barely feel my foot.

name: Chemical splash to the eyes
patient_description: Something splashed in my eyes at work and they're burning.

name: Chest injury
patient_description: My chest hit the steering wheel. It hurts to breathe in.

name: Large, deep burns
patient_description: The burns go all down my arms and back. The skin looks white and leathery.

name: Tense, swollen limb
patient_description: My leg is swelling up tight and the pain is getting worse, not better.
